item.title: Episode 15: What The Office 360 Actually Is (Featuring: The Book That Went From Invisible to Visible)
item.description: Alex and Morgan finally explain what The Office 360 actually does: four people in Lisbon and New York helping authors and publishers whose books are good but invisible. Featuring a real, published case study — a backlist title that climbed from Amazon Grade E to C, and another from D to B, in about eight weeks.
